extractedText: GPT for SheetsBulk toolsUse casesBusiness applicationsOn this pageBusiness applications for spreadsheets🔗Below, you'll find links to example use cases that demonstrate how to apply GPT for Sheets in a range of business domains. To try out the examples, make a copy of our demo spreadsheet and install GPT for Sheets. E-commerce and digital marketing​ E-merchandising, SEO, and Google Shopping​ Improve e-commerce product and service catalogs for SEO and merchandising purposes in digital marketplaces. Tasks include handling product or service variants, duplicating and normalizing content, and performing large-scale catalog optimization. Watch our demo! Try it out! Generate main features from descriptions Generate metadata from product information Generate SEO-friendly product descriptions Classify e-commerce products Extract data from images Extract product attributes from descriptions Translate into multiple languages with GPT functions Translate precisely with bulk tools Reformat product descriptions as HTML Remove ALL CAPS from product titles Remove HTML from content Non-e-commerce SEO​ Generate and optimize digital marketing content outside the e-commerce context. The content includes blog posts, landing page texts, and SEO metadata. The focus is on improving organic visibility and engagement. Try it out! Generate blog post ideas Generate SEO keywords Paid ads​ Generate and optimize ad content for digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Tasks include creating headlines, generating descriptions, rephrasing call-to-actions (CTAs), and adapting keywords to maximize relevance and click-through rates (CTRs). Try it out! Generate Google Search Ads headlines Find Google Shopping product categories Social media posts​ Plan, draft, and adapt content for social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X. Tasks include copywriting posts, suggesting hashtags, generating post variants for A/B testing purposes, and adapting tone and style to match a specific target audience or brand voice. Try it out! Generate LinkedIn posts Market research and analysis​ Generate concise descriptions of companies or markets, gather information about a company's activities, offerings, and industry classification, and analyze market variables, such as size, growth, share, trends, and key players. The purpose is to inform business strategies. Watch our demo! Try it out!
